result.reason: The redline adds the requested professional and workmanlike services warranty, durations exceeding both fallback thresholds, the required remedy alternatives, and a malicious-code warranty. Neither level is fully satisfied because software conformity and legal compliance are qualified by “in all material respects,” and the conformance warranty does not expressly cover all deliverables. The changes remain confined to the warranty framework and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms or contradict the existing disclaimer, which already excepts express warranties.
